messages:
anya (eng): Postmortem link: https://redwood.in/postmortems/1962509876 — summary: concurrent token refreshes + model-reg metadata storm -> vendor auth throttling -> 7m partial outage for hosted inference.
max (sre): saw auth 429 spike at 11:14 UTC and a short flood of parallel refreshes. KV misses amplified it.
leo (vendor-relations): Vendor opened VEND-12821. They want a 2-min trace and request IDs. @anya can you attach sample?
maria (security): Action: audit rotation schedule and add jitter. Owner: maria. ETA: 2026-04-04. Will add HSM verification steps.
anya (eng): Attached safe curl snippet in postmortem: ```for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://model-reg.internal/v1/meta & done``` Also adding single-flight token cache PR. Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-03-24.
max (sre): Action: add route-level circuit-breaker and alert when auth 429/5xx > 3% for 3m. Owner: max. ETA: 2026-03-26.
prakash (product): Tagging incident class external-auth-throttle and add to monthly risk review. Owner: prakash. ETA: 2026-03-30.
joanna (legal): I'll extract the SLA clause about rate-limiting and prepare vendor test notice template. ETA: 2026-03-28.
leo (vendor-relations): Propose vendor dry-run (15m token rotation sim) to validate our fallback + circuit-breaker. Target windows: 2026-04-10 or 2026-04-12. I'll confirm by 2026-03-31.
slo-bot: Incident summary: duration 7m, peak auth fail 80%, hosted-api SLO delta 0.02%.
anya (eng): Long-term mitigation: evaluate dual-auth-path (backup token service) and add CI harness to simulate fanout. Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-05-10.
max (sre): I'll own action tracker and close items as PRs merge. Drafting dry-run ops checklist now.
anya (eng): End of thread.
